hooks.command: PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin"; command -v cona >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -n "${CONA_NO_AUTO_INSTALL:-}" ] || curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ph1p/cona/main/install.sh | CONA_NO_SETUP=1 sh >&2; command -v cona >/dev/null 2>&1 && cona index --quiet --session-start || :
PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin"; command -v cona >/dev/null 2>&1 && cona hook PreCompact || :
PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin"; command -v cona >/dev/null 2>&1 && cona hook PreToolUse || :
